description: The kinds of work Nutcracker knows, each with what it returns (gives), the shapes it starts from (takes) and the shape it hands on (makes). Shapes run brief, evidence, insight, strategy, idea, platform, execution; review judges finished work. Name one in the brief when it fits ("run a 4C Scan"); otherwise describe the outcome and Nutcracker picks.
name: list_work
title: List kinds of work
